Name: (SDR) Ultra Mega Farm
Author: klatuprism
Description: An expansion for Stardew Realty.  Adds a new farm plot of 250x250 tiles complete with a fishing pond, ore mining and treasure areas.  There is also an internal mine cart network to help you navigate the giant piece of land.  The expansion is available in year 4 for 100,000 gold pieces.  In the game the expansion is named "Petawawa Plains".  I didn't like the name Utra Mega Farm, but Nexus does not allow changing mod names and I had already started the mod page.

Manifest.Name: Petawawa Plains Farm
Manifest.Description: An extremely large farm expansion. 57,459 plantable tiles.
